lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Everyone keeps talking about AI agents. Isn't that just a fancy chatbot?
lines.ipa: ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn kˈiːps tˈɔːkɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt ˌeɪˈaɪ ˈeɪdʒənts. ˌɪzənt ðæt dʒˈʌst ɐ fˈænsi tʃˈætbɑːt?

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: Not quite! A chatbot is like a smart helper you talk to. You ask a question, and it gives you an answer.
lines.ipa: nˌɑːt kwˈaɪt! ɐ tʃˈætbɑːt ɪz lˈaɪk ɐ smˈɑːɹt hˈɛlpɚ juː tˈɔːk tuː. juː ˈæsk ɐ kwˈɛstʃən, ænd ɪt ɡˈɪvz juː ɐn ˈænsɚ.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Like when I ask it for a pasta recipe?
lines.ipa: lˈaɪk wɛn aɪ ˈæsk ɪt fɚɹə pˈɑːstɚ ɹˈɛsᵻpˌiː?

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: Exactly. It answers, and then it waits for your next message. You still do all the work.
lines.ipa: ɛɡzˈæktli. ɪɾ ˈænsɚz, ænd ðˈɛn ɪt wˈeɪts fɔːɹ jʊɹ nˈɛkst mˈɛsɪdʒ. juː stˈɪl dˈuː ˈɔːl ðə wˈɜːk.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: So what does an agent do differently?
lines.ipa: sˌoʊ wʌt dˈʌz ɐn ˈeɪdʒənt dˈuː dˈɪfɹəntli?

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: An agent gets a goal, not just a question. It breaks the goal into steps, uses tools like search, calendars, or email, and then checks its own results.
lines.ipa: ɐn ˈeɪdʒənt ɡˈɛts ɐ ɡˈoʊl, nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst ɐ kwˈɛstʃən. ɪt bɹˈeɪks ðə ɡˈoʊl ˌɪntʊ stˈɛps, jˈuːsᵻz tˈuːlz lˈaɪk sˈɜːtʃ, kˈæləndɚz, ɔːɹ ˈiːmeɪl, ænd ðˈɛn tʃˈɛks ɪts ˈoʊn ɹɪzˈʌlts.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Show me with a real example.
lines.ipa: ʃˈoʊ mˌiː wɪð ɐ ɹˈiːəl ɛɡzˈæmpəl.

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: Say you want a weekend trip. A chatbot gives you a list of ideas. An agent checks the weather, compares train times, finds a hotel in your budget, and drafts the whole plan.
lines.ipa: sˈeɪ juː wˈɔnt ɐ wˈiːkɛnd tɹˈɪp. ɐ tʃˈætbɑːt ɡˈɪvz juː ɐ lˈɪst ʌv aɪdˈiəz. ɐn ˈeɪdʒənt tʃˈɛks ðə wˈɛðɚ, kəmpˈɛɹz tɹˈeɪn tˈaɪmz, fˈaɪndz ɐ hoʊtˈɛl ɪn jʊɹ bˈʌdʒɪt, ænd dɹˈæfts ðə hˈoʊl plˈæn.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Wow. But I don't want it booking anything without asking me!
lines.ipa: wˈaʊ. bˌʌt aɪ dˈoʊnt wˈɔnt ɪt bˈʊkɪŋ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ wɪðˌaʊt ˈæskɪŋ mˌiː!

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: And it shouldn't. Good agents ask your permission before important actions, like paying or sending emails. You stay in control.
lines.ipa: ænd ɪt ʃˈʊdənt. ɡˈʊd ˈeɪdʒənts ˈæsk jʊɹ pɚmˈɪʃən bᵻfˌɔːɹ ɪmpˈɔːɹtənt ˈækʃənz, lˈaɪk pˈeɪɪŋ ɔːɹ sˈɛndɪŋ ˈiːmeɪlz. juː stˈeɪ ɪn kəntɹˈoʊl.

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: Yes, they can. So always check their work, just like you would with a new assistant.
lines.ipa: jˈɛs, ðeɪ kˈæn. sˌoʊ ˈɔːlweɪz tʃˈɛk ðɛɹ wˈɜːk, dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk juː wʊd wɪð ɐ nˈuː ɐsˈɪstənt.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: So, a chatbot answers. An agent acts.
lines.ipa: sˈoʊ, ɐ tʃˈætbɑːt ˈænsɚz. ɐn ˈeɪdʒənt ˈækts.

lines.speaker: TEEN
lines.text: You got it! Follow AI Nation Studio for more AI, explained simply.
lines.ipa: juː ɡˈɑːt ɪt! fˈɑːloʊ ˌeɪˈaɪ nˈeɪʃən stˈuːdɪˌoʊ fɔːɹ mˈɔːɹ ˌeɪˈaɪ, ɛksplˈeɪnd sˈɪmpli.
